mainEntity.name: What are the best materials for a covered deck in the Bay Area climate?

acceptedAnswer.text: For covered decks in the Bay Area, common material choices include pressure-treated lumber, redwood, cedar, and composite decking. Pressure-treated lumber is economical and durable, while redwood and cedar offer natural beauty and decay resistance. Composite decking provides excellent longevity and low maintenance, ideal for areas with varying humidity. A practical tradeoff to consider is between initial cost and long-term maintenance; natural wood requires regular sealing and staining, whereas composite typically only needs occasional cleaning.
acceptedAnswer.description: Popular covered deck materials in the Bay Area include pressure-treated lumber, redwood, cedar, and composite decking, each offering different balances of cost, durability, and maintenance.
